purpose: Round L final non-regression re-bench (plan step F.3, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-01-post-audit-stabilization.md) — driver-bench standard protocol compared against the frozen round budgets before merging.

git.head: de18b5b6e51ebceadbe26de1e6940d56c6aa304a
git.head_subject: Merge branch 'fix/audit-2026-10-01-phpstan' — Round L: align fallbacks and fakes with the precise stub shapes

extension.build_note: The extension-tests feature (= rabbit-rs-core/test-support) gates test-only constructors/observers (e.g. with_closed_pump_for_tests, buffered_bytes()); no measured code path differs from the round-l-profile build (built without the flag at the same 0.3.10 version). Sources verified not newer than the artifact before the runs.
extension.loading: php -n -d extension=<dylib> per run, never installed system-wide

php.xdebug_free_assertion: Every measured process ran under `php -n -d extension=<dylib>` — no ini files. extension_loaded('xdebug') === false verified in the probe (raw/probe-config-echo.json meta) and the flag guarantees it for all runs; per-run stderr captured and asserted empty (total 0 bytes across the 15 gate runs + probe).

lab.broker: 3-node RabbitMQ 4.2.9 cluster, fresh volumes (./scripts/lab-up.sh default with-plugin profile: delayed-message plugin enabled, Prometheus + Toxiproxy up)
lab.readiness: ./scripts/lab-ready.sh passed. First attempt failed at the 3-node cluster check (management API answered before nodes 2/3 finished joining — startup race, no retry on that step); passed unchanged on re-run ~1 min later. No lab or config change involved.
lab.queue_type_verification: bench.goopil.driver-bench on vhost / verified classic+durable via the management API before and after the runs (matches every frozen archive).

configuration.protocol: driver-bench standard protocol: bin/bench.php --count=1000 --rounds=10, 3 interleaved passes per cell, one JSON per run under raw/
configuration.payload: 1024 B Laravel envelope (payload_body_bytes=1024 in every run)

rabbit_rs.safety: safe default (.env); blind cells override via RABBIT_RS_SAFETY=blind process env

configuration.vendor: goopil/rabbit-rs-laravel vendored copy refreshed via `composer update goopil/rabbit-rs-laravel --ignore-platform-req=ext-amqp` before the runs; `diff -rq vendor/goopil/rabbit-rs-laravel/src packages/laravel-queue/src` byte-identical afterwards (the stale-vendor trap documented in round-i/round-l-profile).

machine_load.note: The machine was NOT quiet: 1-min load averages 11.99-15.42 across the passes (load-observations.csv), comparable to or higher than the round-l-profile session (5.7-13.1). Per the workload-scoped framing rules, medians over interleaved runs and same-session ratios are the comparison contract, not absolute cross-session deltas.

deviations: benchmarks/driver-bench/config/rabbit-rs.php carried an UNCOMMITTED patch during the runs: flat 'queue_type' => 'classic' added next to the dead nested 'topology' block (ConnectionCompiler reads only flat keys, so the committed config silently yields the package default quorum). Same procedure as results/round-l-profile (patch kept for measurement, reverted after). Reverted before committing this archive.

benchmarks/driver-bench/composer.lock was modified by the vendor refresh (path-repo source reference 0ac0aad -> 808bee4) and restored to the committed state after the runs to keep the archive commit scoped. The vendored copy used for the runs is byte-identical to packages/laravel-queue/src.
Extension built with --features extension-tests per the gate instruction (test-only code; see extension.build_note).
Vladimir cells ran under the same xdebug-free invocation (php -n) as the goopil cells so the session control shares the measured environment (older archives ran it under the default ini).
provenance_discipline: Follows results/round-l-profile: per-run JSON with meta (php/rabbit_rs/os), xdebug-free assertion, load observations bracketing every pass, stderr captured per run and asserted empty.
